name: Elden Vale Sanctuary

landmarks.name: Reserve entrance
landmarks.description: An old arch marks the way into the sanctuary reserve. The woodland path leads back to Elden Vale.

landmarks.name: Sanctuary Hall
landmarks.description: The pale stone hall and sheltered cloister are kept for visitors, quiet company and the care of the reserve.

landmarks.name: Memorial Grove
landmarks.description: Old trees and young plantings grow together. Neighbours tend this living grove in remembrance of those they have lost.

landmarks.name: Grove Clearing
landmarks.description: Faint lights drift between the leaves where the vale’s natural aether currents gather.

landmarks.name: Ridge Cave
landmarks.description: Roots cling to a natural opening in the limestone ridge. Weathered traces of masonry remain beside it. A rope closes the entrance while the inner path is checked.

landmarks.name: Surveyed Stone Face
landmarks.description: Survey stakes mark an intact limestone seam within the protected reserve, away from the sanctuary hall. No stone has been cut here.

navigation_policy: All open ground is walkable. Only visible object footprints and the reserve boundary are solid; the paths guide exploration without restricting it.
